evidence.excerpt: Synthetic allocation used only to make the complete-rack-to-site scope transition executable.
evidence.title: Synthetic Abilene-target shipment allocation

links.confirming_evidence: A frozen manufacturing release with the same platform topology, quarter, and material-cleared package-start basis supports the complete-system range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The source topology or package-start basis differs, the source result is revised, or observed package output falls outside the linked range.
links.notes: Replaces logic-die, aggregate-HBM, package-throughput, silicon-interposer, and ABF-substrate placeholders because the frozen manufacturing result reconciles logic and supplier HBM with package starts explicitly declared material-cleared.
links.resource_name: Frozen material-cleared supplier-HBM manufacturing system equivalents

links.confirming_evidence: A frozen assembly release with matching rack topology, non-overlapping ODM scopes, and declared component-cleared output supports the complete-rack range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The source topology, ODM scopes, component coverage, or output basis differs, or observed complete-rack output falls outside the linked range.
links.notes: Replaces server and rack assembly placeholders because the frozen source locally reconciles ODM compute-tray and rack-integration flows and consumes each declared NIC, DPU, switch-tray, management-switch, power-shelf, and cooling pool once. The scope and capacities remain synthetic.

links.confirming_evidence: Customer allocation, purchase-order, logistics, or receiving records support this share of frozen complete-rack output moving to the selected site.
links.falsifying_evidence: Allocation or receiving records show a materially different site share or that the assembly source covers a different supply scope.
links.notes: Creates the explicit scope transition from component-cleared complete-rack output to a synthetic Abilene-target shipped subset. It is not an observed customer allocation.

platform_allocation.confirming_evidence: Dated customer allocation and site receiving records support a six-percent central share for the same complete-rack population.
platform_allocation.falsifying_evidence: Shipment destinations, purchase orders, or receiving logs put the selected site's share outside four to eight percent.
platform_allocation.methodology: Synthetic share chosen only to exercise a customer-and-site allocation boundary after complete-rack assembly.

links.confirming_evidence: A frozen site-operational release for the same site, platform class, and quarter supports the operational-rack range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The site scope or rack class differs, the source result is revised, or rack-level acceptance records fall outside the range.
links.notes: Replaces separate illustrative power and commissioning constraints because the frozen operational result already takes their minimum after site deductions.

scenario.name: GB200 supplier-HBM, ODM-assembly, and Abilene chain demonstrator
scenario.notes: Frozen material-cleared manufacturing, component-cleared system assembly, and site-operational results replace overlapping synthetic constraints. All throughput, component, site-share, and deployment inputs remain synthetic unless explicitly labeled otherwise.
scenario.scope_notes: Package output represents the selected illustrative Blackwell manufacturing flow. Component-cleared complete racks then represent three synthetic non-overlapping ODM scopes after exact server and rack resources are consumed once. A shipped-stage synthetic allocation narrows later output to the Abilene-target subset. Factory qualification, logistics, site installation, deployment infrastructure, supplier economics, consensus, and opportunity ranking remain separate or outside this run.

datacenter_operational.scope: One selected Abilene campus target-platform operational envelope.

manufacturing.scope: Illustrative Blackwell manufacturing flow with exact supplier HBM draws and synthetic material-cleared package starts.

system_assembly.scope: Illustrative three-ODM GB200 assembly flow with exact capacity draws and synthetic component-cleared complete-rack output.
